test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, “I have finished my homework.”

options.text: He said that he had finished his homework.
He said that he would finish his homework.
He said that he had to finish his homework.
He said that he has finished his homework.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he had finished his homework.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun:**
 
 
• In direct speech, the pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the reporting verb.
 
 
 
• **Tense:**
 
 
• The present perfect tense "have finished" is changed to the past perfect tense "had finished" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" remains unchanged as no additional action (e.g., asking, telling) is indicated.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a subordinate clause introduced by "that."
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said that he had finished his homework."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "He said that he would finish his homework." – Incorrect tense (future simple instead of past perfect).
 
• **Option 3:** "He said that he had to finish his homework." – Changes the meaning (obligation instead of completion).
 
• **Option 4:** "He said that he has finished his homework." – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past perfect).
